landing.heroSubtitle: A personalized AI learning companion that creates fun, targeted educational experiences for your kids. Dodi adapts to each child's age, skills, and interests.
landing.featureSmartDesc: Dodi answers curious questions, tells stories, and helps with homework — all tailored to your child.
landing.featureGamesDesc: AI-generated educational games that match your child's level and interests. New games every day.
landing.featurePrivacyDesc: Parents have full control. All data is encrypted. No tracking, no ads, no third-party sharing.
landing.featurePersonalDesc: Customize Dodi's personality, appearance, and learning style. Make it truly your child's companion.
landing.step1Desc: Sign up and set up your child's profile with their age and interests.
landing.step2Desc: Bring your own API key from providers like Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, or Grok.
landing.step3Desc: Your child interacts with Dodi via text or voice. Dodi creates personalized games and adapts over time.
landing.footer: Dodi. Made with love in Austria for kids around the world.
